$comment: App-store-style privacy manifest for Nostalgic Requests. Generated from the product's real behaviour on 2026-07-27 by scanning collected fields, payment integration, and analytics SDKs. If you add a tracker or a new collected field, update this file in the same commit as the code change.
verificationMethod: Static scan of app/ and lib/ for collected fields, payment SDKs, and analytics initialization.

thirdPartyAnalyticsSdks.name: @vercel/analytics
thirdPartyAnalyticsSdks.collects: Page views, referrer, device type, coarse geo
thirdPartyAnalyticsSdks.note: Vercel Web Analytics is cookieless and does not build cross-site profiles, but it is still a third-party processor and must be disclosed.

dataCollected.note: Free-text user-generated content displayed to a performer. This is the UGC surface that makes a DMCA policy and designated agent necessary.
Card numbers are never touched by this application — Stripe Checkout and Stripe Connect handle card data directly. Only Stripe identifiers are stored.

openGaps: Privacy policy does not yet name @vercel/analytics as a processor — this manifest is ahead of the policy page.
DMCA Designated Agent not yet registered with the U.S. Copyright Office (dmca@nostalgicrequests.com mailbox must exist first).
Terms name Toronto, Ontario as the arbitration seat and contact address; the operator relocated to Montreal in 2026-07. Changing an arbitration seat is a legal decision, not a find-replace.
No AI/LLM processing occurs in this application, so no FTC AI disclosure was added. Re-check if AI features are introduced.
